top_signals.title: Nvidia’s CEO Search Draws Fire; ‘Max Overweight’ on Stocks
top_signals.summary:
Pressure is mounting on Nvidia Corp. days after it ousted Jensen Huang as chief executive officer, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urging the company to make a “dramatic” leadership shakeup and come clean about its compliance with export controls on its prized AI chips.

Morgan Stanley strategists recommended a “max overweight” position in global stocks, citing an intact AI capital spending cycle that will extend resilient economic and earnings growth into next year.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Italy boosts GCAP fighter spending as Army vehicles take a hit in budget
top_signals.summary: Italy has hiked its spending on the GCAP fighter this year while reducing funding for new army tanks and fighting vehicles, newly released spending documents have revealed.
